subject: Deployment pathway: MAP checkpoints — mode & region decision
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@acoustech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment pathway: MAP checkpoints — mode & region decision

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday to walk through the product demo. Per our conversation I attached an updated Mutual Action Plan (Acoustech_MAP_v2.xlsx) and the security questionnaire you asked for (security_questionnaire.pdf). The MAP contains recommended evaluation milestones, gating criteria, and a proposed close timeline.

Two asks to keep the plan moving:
- Preferred deployment mode for production (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — we need a firm directional decision by EOD Thu 24 Jun to lock capacity quotes and procurement timelines.
- Preferred primary region (US-East / US-West / EU) for data residency and latency SLAs.

High-level proposal (also in the MAP):
1) POC on Hosted (us-east) for 2–3 week functional + perf eval (low setup time).
2) If perf and security gates pass, reserve Dedicated capacity in us-east for prod (12-month commit) with canary cutover.
3) Private (VPC) option remains for a later phase if you require on-prem/network isolation — we can add that to the MAP as a stretch goal.

Hannah copied here to flag any technical constraints we should bake into the MAP (lead times, telemetry needs, VPN/KMS notes). Lauren will call out SLA/monitoring and acceptance gates.

If you can confirm preferred mode + region by Thu 24 Jun we’ll publish a final MAP and a procurement checklist that your team can share with legal/procurement.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Acoustech_MAP_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), security_questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@acoustech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Acoustech Procurement <procurement@acoustech.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway: MAP checkpoints — mode & region decision

Marcus — thanks for the materials and for the clear cadence. Quick visibility from our side:
- Our security/compliance team requires US-only data residency for PII and logs. That pushes us to us-east or us-west for production.
- Procurement is targeting an execution window in early July; they will need a finalized scope and T&Cs to generate a PO.
- For predictability, we prefer Dedicated for prod (isolation + steady throughput). Hosted is fine for an initial POC if it’s easier on lead time, but our legal team has two questions about data escrow and logging retention that the security questionnaire didn’t fully address.

Action items for Redwood: can you give a ballpark lead time for Dedicated capacity in us-east and a short note on how audit logs/data retention are handled (SOC2 references are helpful). Also, is it possible to get a committed cost estimate for a 12-month reserved pool (we’ll share expected monthly tokens offline)?

I looped procurement for transparency — they can follow up about PO formatting.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Gomez
Head of ML Platforms, Acoustech
sarah.gomez@acoustech.com

(On Mon, Jun 20, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com> wrote:)
> [original MAP and proposal attached]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@acoustech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway: MAP checkpoints — mode & region decision

Hi Sarah / Marcus — quick engineering note to make the MAP implementation-ready:

1) Dedicated lead time: 6–8 weeks to provision reserved GPU pools in a new region assuming standard instance types. If you need a specific GPU SKU or private networking we should budget extra (2–3 weeks).

2) Hosted-for-POC approach (recommended phased plan):
   - Week 0: Hosted staging in us-east (short DNS and key setup) — baseline functional tests and smoke perf.
   - Week 1–2: Run our evaluation harness (attached capacity_estimate.csv) with representative traffic (we’ll share a small script) and gather p50/p95 latency and token cost metrics.
   - Gate: perf p50 < 120ms and p95 < 350ms on your 90th percentile request mix AND no high-severity findings in the security questionnaire responses.

3) Data residency & logs: Hosted keeps customer logs in region-bound storage by default; audit logs are retained 90 days in the hosted plan (we can extend retention for Dedicated/Private). We are SOC 2 Type II compliant — I attached the SOC reference links in the MAP. For legal: we support KMS integrations and can provide key-wrap proofs for Dedicated/Private deployments.

4) Networking & KMS for Private: Private deployments require a network review and a short on-site blackout window for the initial handshake (if on-prem). That’s a separate planning line in the MAP.

If you’re comfortable with the phased approach, we can start Hosted POC as soon as you confirm region and provide an account for API keys. I’ll coordinate with infra to reserve Dedicated capacity once procurement signals a formal commit.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_estimate.csv (text/csv)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com>
To: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@acoustech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway: MAP checkpoints — mode & region decision

Hi all — product/ops clarifications to make the MAP gating explicit:

Acceptance gates (for moving POC -> Dedicated prod):
- Functional: 0 critical defects in the evaluation test set and stable API compatibility across 3 days of continuous traffic.
- Performance: p50 latency < 120ms, p95 < 350ms on the representative mix provided by Acoustech.
- Cost: token unit cost at or below the target in the MAP (we put a conservative estimate; we’ll update once we run the baseline).
- Observability: token-level tracing and route-level dashboards enabled; retention window aligned with your compliance needs.

SLA/pricing note: Dedicated 12-month reserved SKU includes a 12% discount vs on-demand hosted and includes 99.9% SLA. Private deployments carry an additional setup fee for network integration. I’ll share a short pricing appendix once Marcus confirms target token volume.

Marcus: if procurement needs a one-page statement of work (SOW) with milestones, I can produce that by Thu if we have a mode + region decision.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Product Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@acoustech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway: MAP checkpoints — mode & region decision

Folks — thanks for the thorough notes. After internal alignment with security and procurement: we are comfortable with the phased plan. Final decisions:

- POC: Hosted in us-east (start immediately).
- Prod commitment: Dedicated pool in us-east, 12-month reserved capacity. Procurement aims to issue PO by next Tue (29 Jun).
- Private/VPC: keep as Phase 2; we may evaluate in Q4 for network isolation.

I attached the preliminary PO (Acoustech_PO_000412.pdf) and an executed MSA (signed_MSA.pdf). Procurement will route the formal purchase order next week once you provide the SOW and the capacity SKU for the reserved commitment.

Next steps action list I’ve requested internally:
1) Marcus: publish the final MAP with the procurement checklist and SOW stub.
2) Hannah: provide the reserved SKU options and an estimated activation date (calendar-range).
3) Lauren: pricing appendix and gating criteria incorporated into the SOW.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Gomez
Head of ML Platforms, Acoustech
Attachments: Acoustech_PO_000412.pdf (application/pdf), signed_MSA.pdf (application/pdf)
